Learn plays the singular and the plural as two lines with their own photos (One bus. over A1's bus photo, then Two buses. over two buses at a stop; one watch from A1+ 2.3, then three watches; A1's man and woman, then two men walking and three women on a park bench). Picture cards set the singular photo against the plural photo (It is a bus. / They are buses.), so the plural form is what decides; count cards change only the number; How many …? replies change only the number.

lesson.title: 2.9 Buses, watches, men and women
lesson.unit_title: Places, things and how we describe them
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people go and how they get there, talk about the things people have, point things out and compare them, put things in order, and ask about favorites.
lesson.goal: Say more than one with the -es plural and the irregular plurals men and women (One bus. Two buses. / One man. Two men. / They are women.).
lesson.grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 2.9 Count and Describe: A1 adds -s for more than one (two books, three cars); A1+ 2.9 adds the two plural spellings it left out: -es after s and ch (bus, buses; watch, watches) and the irregular man, men and woman, women. Learn sets each singular photo against its plural photo (One bus. / Two buses.), and practice says They are …, the count, and where they are.
lesson.prerequisite: A1 2.9 plural -s; A1 2.2 bus; A1+ 2.3 watch; A1 1.1 man, woman; A1 2.6-2.7 numbers; A1+ 1.5 How many …?
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say buses and watches with an extra syllable (BUS-iz, WATCH-iz); say men like 'men' and women like 'WIM-in'. Do not require native-like speed.
